title: TestReport artifact
description: Produced by the VERIFY state. No model is involved in its creation. The exit code is the sole determinant of Task success (ADR-0014); the normalised output exists so that the progress oracle and the prompt reducer see the same thing.

exit_code.description: Null only when outcome is not_verified: the command did not run to completion. Null MUST NOT be rendered as zero.

failing_count.description: Parsed count of failing checks, or 1 when the output cannot be parsed. The fallback is conservative on purpose: an unparseable output can never show a reduction, so the progress oracle falls back to comparing signatures alone and stops earlier rather than later.

failure_signature.description: sha256 over normalised output concatenated with the exit code. Null when outcome is verified.

normalised_output.description: Truncated to the configured number of failures, with absolute paths, timestamps, durations, addresses, temporary names, pids and random ids removed.

raw_output_sha256.description: The untruncated log, stored as an artifact and referenced rather than inlined.

pre_change_run.description: Present for Tasks of kind 'test'. The command must have failed against the pre-change tree, otherwise the test verifies nothing.
